The '''Neolsse family''' was a family that ruled [[Keremark]] and [[Fortress Keremark]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Risban]]. They fought against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] when the Empire attempted to conquer the planet.<ref name="TCSWE" />
